description: This Java source file defines the WavePanelSandbox class which extends FrameHelper. It creates a GUI panel that displays an engine sniffer chart based on a report string containing engine trigger data, and provides methods to print angles for a specific range. It includes a main method to run the sandbox application.

classes.name: WavePanelSandbox
classes.description: Main class for a GUI sandbox that displays engine trigger waveforms and allows angle analysis.

methods.name: WavePanelSandbox
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the engine sniffer panel, processes a report string, displays the chart, and shows the GUI frame.

methods.name: printAngles
methods.description: Splits report data and prints formatted events for a specific range of engine trigger times.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method to run the sandbox GUI on the Swing event dispatch thread.
